summary: This is a 90-day execution plan for a biotech/research project (MIRA_ARGUS) focused on centriole age-based division timing. It outlines six concrete deliverables with dates and required artifacts, defines pre-registered primary/secondary endpoints, maps open criticisms to corrective actions, and provides a calendar through March 2027. The document is structured to support a TRL re-assessment request, with current TRL transitions explicitly stated (TRL 3→4 and 4→5).

content_blocks.title: Document Purpose and Rule
content_blocks.content: A 90-day execution plan for the MIRA_ARGUS project (VitaDAO/GLA grant context). Rule: every line is either a deliverable with a date and an artifact, or a mapping from a criticism to the action that answers it. Nothing is a promise without a file behind it. The plan is structured to support a TRL re-assessment request to be submitted by 1 Mar 2027.

content_blocks.title: Deliverables Table — Six Milestones with Dates, Artifacts, Workstreams, and TRL Effects
content_blocks.content:
Six deliverables are listed:
1. Fiducial autofocus prototype mounted on the OpenFlexure fork | Due: 15 Jan 2027 | Artifact: Photo log, CAD revision, wiring note in hardware/ | Workstream: W2 | TRL effect: 3→4
2. 72h focus-hold test, drift plotted | Due: 20 Jan 2027 | Artifact: CSV of focus error vs time, plot, summary in docs/ | Workstream: W2 | TRL effect: closes P0 gap against Axio Observer
3. Protocol pre-registration deposited (OSF or Zenodo) | Due: before first imaging run | Artifact: DOI, timestamp, immutable version | Workstream: W1 | TRL effect: removes 'analysis can drift' objection
4. Unattended end-to-end run on fixed samples producing a tracked-division log | Due: 31 Jan 2027 | Artifact: machine-readable log, run config, error report | Workstream: W3 | TRL effect: 4→5
5. Second contributor onboarded (advisory or paid) | Due: 28 Feb 2027 | Artifact: name, role, signed scope, first commit or first review | Workstream: team | TRL effect: removes single-programmer objection
6. Re-assessment request with 1–4 attached | Due: 1 Mar 2027 | Artifact: request text + attachments | Workstream: all | TRL effect: new score

Slip policy: If items 1, 2, and 4 slip, the corresponding workstream stays at its current level and the slip is reported with the artifact that shows it.

content_blocks.title: Primary Endpoint Definition (Pre-Registration)
content_blocks.content:
The primary endpoint must be numeric and locked before the first imaging run:
- Primary: inherited centriole age rank predicts the interdivision interval in the same cell, tested by a pre-specified rank correlation with a stated effect-size floor; failure threshold fixed in advance.
- Secondary: division-interval variance explained by centriole age after controlling for cell volume and birth time.
- Futility rule: if the first cohort shows no association above the floor, the hypothesis is reported as not supported in that system and the paper says so.
Key constraint: the effect-size floor must not be tuned after seeing data — this is what separates a pre-registration from a press release.

content_blocks.title: Criticism → Action → Expected Movement Table (Page 1)
content_blocks.content:
Open objections and their responses:
1. Entirely prospective, one level for everything → Per-workstream table plus artifacts 1, 2, 4 → §2 of the supplement, items 1–4
2. Therapeutic relevance indirect → A validated division-timing readout, not a target claim; endpoint locked in item 3 → element table, item 3

content_blocks.title: Criticism → Action → Expected Movement Table (Page 2)
content_blocks.content:
Continued open objections and responses:
3. Optionality: one cell system, no second tested → One intervention class producing a dose-ordered shift in division timing, second cell system post-pilot, next review
4. IP: open licences, no filings → Method claims named, filing gate dated, cost line-itemed → §4, gate at 60 days after positive pilot
5. Small team, one programmer → Item 5, plus verified test count (29 — 12 pytest, 17 Rust, stated in TRL evidence pack), frozen spec, written procedures, public upstream patch → §5, team field answer
6. No funding → OSC and Foresight pending, STF rejection declared with reason → §5
7. Input set: attachments missing → Artifact index; the missing input was files, not plan → §3, attachments 1–4

content_blocks.title: What Not To Do — Constraints and Guardrails
content_blocks.content:
Key constraints stated explicitly:
- Biology workstream moves on G4 data only; no document argues its level up — the artifact moves it or nothing does.
- Do not claim Caltech correspondence as a collaboration; it is correspondence only.
- Do not resubmit to Sovereign Tech Fund before Q4 2027; the prevalence criterion needs adopters, not a better draft.
- Provisional patent filed at G5, 60 days after a positive endpoint; before that, method is disclosed defensively. A weak filing is worse than a defensive publication plus a dated gate.
- Do not inflate team size for a scoring effect; a second contributor with a signed scope beats five names.

content_blocks.title: Paper Trail and File Management
content_blocks.content: All documents to be kept in: ~/Desktop/Services/grants/GLA/VitaDAO_ARGUS/MIRA_ARGUS_2026-11/ — this plan, the supplement, the field answers, and every attachment as submitted. One folder, same filenames as the request, so the review thread stays auditable a year from now.

content_blocks.title: Calendar Summary
content_blocks.content:
Consolidated calendar:
- 15 Jan 2027: items 1 and 2 (autofocus prototype + 72h focus-hold test)
- Before first imaging run: item 3 (protocol pre-registration)
- 31 Jan 2027: item 4 (unattended end-to-end run)
- 28 Feb 2027: item 5 (second contributor onboarded)
- 1 Mar 2027: item 6 (re-assessment request sent)

key_findings: Current TRL is approximately 3; deliverables 1 and 2 are expected to advance W2 to TRL 4, and deliverable 4 is expected to advance W3 to TRL 5.
Primary experimental system: centriole age-based prediction of interdivision interval in live cells, tested by rank correlation with a pre-specified effect-size floor.
Hardware: fiducial autofocus prototype being built on an OpenFlexure fork (open-source microscopy platform); 72h focus-hold stability test planned.
Software test suite verified: 29 tests total (12 pytest, 17 Rust), cited as evidence against single-programmer objection.
Pre-registration of protocol (OSF or Zenodo) required before first imaging run to prevent analysis drift.
Unattended end-to-end automated imaging run on fixed samples is the key TRL 4→5 gate (deliverable 4, due 31 Jan 2027).
IP strategy: method claims named but not yet filed; provisional patent planned at G5 milestone, 60 days after positive endpoint; currently using defensive disclosure.
Funding: OSC and Foresight applications pending; Sovereign Tech Fund (STF) application rejected (reason declared); STF resubmission deferred to Q4 2027.
Team: currently single programmer; second contributor onboarding planned by 28 Feb 2027.
Caltech correspondence exists but is explicitly not a collaboration.
Second cell system and dose-ordered intervention class planned post-pilot to address optionality objection.
Biology workstream gated on G4 data only — no document-based level advancement.
